extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. It is designed to enable accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
extraction.creator: Mohamed Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset arabic-img2md was assembled by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website (hindawi.org), converted to PDFs and paired with extracted Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat: the model occasionally generates irrelevant content, including non-existent URLs or images; Repetition issues in arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat, particularly in lengthy sequences; Dataset biases from Hindawi web content limiting generalization to other Arabic text domains; Significant computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat; Performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested; Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts (dense tables, charts, or images) may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and models aim to promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic, contributing to knowledge base creation, information retrieval, and training data generation for Arabic literature.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR models; converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text; downstream Arabic NLP tasks; knowledge base creation; information retrieval; training data generation.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The arabic-img2md dataset was synthetically generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting paired Markdown representations to create 13.7k training samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown counterparts.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired image-Markdown samples for the arabic-img2md dataset.
